title.zh: 先从列正交得到行正交
title.en: Pass from column orthogonality to row orthogonality

given.zh: Hadamard 定义给出 H*H=6I，且 i≠j。
given.en: The Hadamard definition gives H*H=6I, with i≠j.

reason.zh: Hadamard 定义提供的是列正交 H*H=6I；6 在复数域可逆，所以可以构造这个左逆。
reason.en: The Hadamard definition supplies column orthogonality H*H=6I. Six is invertible in ℂ, giving this left inverse.

reason.zh: H 是方阵；源码用 mul_eq_one_comm 把左逆等式交换为右逆等式，再乘回非零标量 6。
reason.en: H is square. The source uses mul_eq_one_comm to obtain the right-inverse equality, then multiplies back by the nonzero scalar six.

reason.zh: 取矩阵等式的不同行列位置；右端 6I 的非对角元为 0，左端按矩阵乘法展开。
reason.en: Take the off-diagonal (i,j) entry. The right side 6I is zero there; expanding the left side gives the stated sum.

title.zh: 逐项平方的正交性给出 ∑vₖ²=0

given.zh: 逐项平方矩阵同样满足 Hadamard 条件。
given.en: The entrywise square also satisfies the Hadamard conditions.

statement.zh: 令 Qᵢₖ=Hᵢₖ²。由 Q*Q=6I 得 QQ*=6I。
statement.en: Set Qᵢₖ=Hᵢₖ². From Q*Q=6I obtain QQ*=6I.

reason.zh: 题目对逐项平方矩阵单独给出了 Hadamard 假设；对 Q 使用同样的方阵左右逆论证。
reason.en: The entrywise-square matrix has its own Hadamard hypothesis. Apply the same left-to-right inverse argument to Q.

reason.zh: i≠j 使 Q 的不同行内积为 0；复共轭保持平方，普通乘法交换使两个平方并成 vₖ²。
reason.en: The distinct rows of Q have zero inner product. Conjugation preserves squares, and commutativity combines the squared factors into vₖ².

reason.zh: 复共轭保持有限和并把 0 映为 0；最终求和时需要的是这个共轭平方矩。
reason.en: Conjugation preserves finite sums and zero. This conjugate-square moment is the one used in the final sum.

title.zh: 模长 1 把三次方和共轭平方联系起来
title.en: Unit modulus links cubes with conjugate squares

given.zh: H 的每个元素模长为1，故 |vₖ|=1。
given.en: Every entry of H has modulus one, hence |vₖ|=1.

reason.zh: H 的 Unimodular 条件逐项给出模长 1，且共轭不改变模长。
reason.en: The Unimodular hypothesis gives modulus one entrywise, and conjugation preserves modulus.

reason.zh: 复数与其共轭的乘积等于模长平方；这一步不需要 a、b 的立方取值条件。
reason.en: A complex number times its conjugate is its squared modulus. This step does not use the two possible cube values a,b.

reason.zh: 先按交换结合律重排，再代入上一行的 1；这为下一阶段的两个立方分支提供相同的代换式。
reason.en: Rearrange by commutativity and associativity, then substitute one from the preceding identity. Both cube-value cases will use this same equality.

title.zh: 构造逐点恒等式，筛出 a 纤维
title.en: Construct a pointwise identity selecting the a-fiber

given.zh: a≠b，且每个 vₖ³ 都等于 a 或 b。
given.en: a≠b and every vₖ³ is a or b.

reason.zh: 把 vₖ³=a 代入上一阶段的 vₖ³conj(vₖ)²=vₖ，得到可替换右侧乘积的等式。
reason.en: Substitute vₖ³=a into vₖ³conj(vₖ)²=vₖ to obtain the needed replacement.

reason.zh: 在 a 纤维上，用前一行把 ab·conj(vₖ)² 改写为 bvₖ；指示函数在此处取 1。
reason.en: On the a-fiber, replace ab·conj(vₖ)² by bvₖ using the preceding equality. The indicator is one in this case.

reason.zh: 同一单位模长等式给出 b·conj(vₖ)²=vₖ；a≠b 保证此时不在 a 纤维，所以指示项也为 0。
reason.en: The unit-modulus equality now gives b·conj(vₖ)²=vₖ. Since a≠b, this is not the a-fiber, and the indicator term is also zero.

title.zh: 求和后消去非零因子 a−b
title.en: Sum and cancel the nonzero factor a−b

given.zh: 逐点纤维恒等式、∑vₖ=0 和 ∑conj(vₖ)²=0 都已成立。
given.en: The pointwise fiber identity and both ∑vₖ=0 and ∑conj(vₖ)²=0 are established.

reason.zh: 把有限过滤求和改成全指标集上的条件求和，再把公共因子移入；这就是 cubeFiber 与 Finset.sum_filter 的展开。
reason.en: Expand cubeFiber using Finset.sum_filter and move the common factor inside, turning the filtered sum into a conditional sum over all indices.

reason.zh: 逐项使用前一阶段的恒等式，再分配有限和；两个独立得到的消失矩在这里汇合。
reason.en: Apply the pointwise identity, distribute the finite sum, and use the two independently established vanishing moments.

reason.zh: 复数域没有零因子，故前一行乘积为 0 时只能消去非零因子 a−b；把 vₖ 换回行比值就得到原目标。
reason.en: The field ℂ has no zero divisors, so cancel the nonzero factor a−b. Replacing vₖ by its row-ratio definition gives the target.
